description.value: Sungiven Foods is a BC-based Asian supermarket chain focused on natural, minimally processed foods, stocking produce, meat, seafood, dairy, and a wide range of packaged and frozen Asian staples. The Richmond One Park location is one of several Lower Mainland stores. The in-store Sungiven Kitchen offers a rotating selection of ready-to-eat prepared hot dishes, making it a practical resupply stop for cyclists wanting a cooked meal alongside full grocery shopping.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: rack at 5m; rack at 64m; rack at 70m; rack at 79m; rack at 83m; rack at 92m; rack at 99m.
